shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), "Traveler" transit animations with a real pre-hop delay, blueprint art, wall risers, Perspective Shift support. Workshop 3776015553, window 10 shipped. Window 11: §78 UNTESTED IN THE FIELD.
body:
**NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 SUPERSEDED by §62; §31 publishing + GIT; §32-40 records; §41-44 combat/senses/travel/CE; §45-50 field-report fixes; §51 Celestial Lighting; §52 field-report round 2; §53 arrival/landing; §54 structure fit; §55 exit grid; §56 Geological Landforms; §57 stale decoration window; §58 relocated-structure fog; §59 forbid-aware islands; §60 area-linear vanilla systems; §61 camera-mod coexistence; §62 utility COLUMN rework + §62.N; §63 stairs permission; §64 cross-level shadow depth; §65 forbidden mirroring; §66 aim/wild-miss/aim-pie; §67 boulder extrusion; §68 KCSG/VFEM2; §69 stair temperature; §70 band flora legality + §70.B (OPEN); §71 Smooth Terrain (RESOLVED; report awaiting paste); §72 link gizmos; §73 transit animations (SUPERSEDED); §74 blueprint art; §75 wall risers; §76 Perspective Shift; §77 motion-study round 2 + §77b railing bug + §77c art defects; **§78 pre-hop delay + §78b-d the field fixes, RE-TEST PENDING**. Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> **⚠⚠ V1 SOURCE IS NOT GONE. DATED SOURCE BACKUPS LIVE AT `D:\Rimworld\As above, So below\<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>\Source\`** (ten snapshots, newest `20260726-154207`). The old note "V1 survives only in git history pre-a50a744" was WRONG and cost a re-derivation. These are `Source/` only - no Defs, no Textures. **When a V2 feature has a V1 ancestor, READ THE V1 FILE FIRST.** Confirmed useful so far: `Source/Stairs/ClimbAnimation.cs` (§78d). Note the tool boundary: `read` refuses that path, `bash`/`grep`/`sed` reach it fine.

# 0. START HERE

**CURRENT PHASE: WINDOW 11. §78d compiles 0w/0e and HAS NOT BEEN RUN.** Three field rounds so far this window; each fixed real defects and found the next one.

**⚠ THE #297 QUESTION IS ANSWERED: THE HOLD DOES NOT DEADLOCK.** Runs 1-3 produced no stuck pawns and no bridge errors; every report has been cosmetic. The §78 mechanism (defer the MOVE, not the DECISION) is sound. If pawns ever stall at stairwells again the suspect list starts with `EntryCellFor`/the sweep's arrival clauses (§78c), NOT the hold.

Window 10 shipped §74/§75/§76 to Workshop 3776015553, pushed as **`afaf614`**. §78 is NOT committed.

**⚠ WORKSPACE DLL IS A DEBUG BUILD.** Rebuild Release before any publish.

**⚠ OWED, IN ORDER:** (1) **RE-TEST §78d.** (2) **WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST** from the WORKSHOP copy - never done for any window. (3) **FINAL riser art** (Gemini PAUSED r5; ⚠ REWRITE prompts to the REAL palette - NO copper: power=steel+blue+hazard, pipe=pale+red valve, climate=ice+louver+orange, data=black+purple+cyan). (4) **FOREIGN PRINT-PATH AUDIT** (ledger 3). (5) **§77c ART** - grand staircase east/west sprites unrotated; user's domain. (6) §62.N formal line. (7) Smooth Terrain upstream paste. (8) §70 Caverns verify. (9) Delete the retired ghost stubs. (10) **AnimationDef pipeline port** (§78d, OFFERED NOT ACCEPTED).

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (Workshop):** §62.N, §70 (w8); §62.M, §66c, §66e (w7). **⚠ PLACEHOLDER ART:** the 12 riser PNGs, by explicit user decision.

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans COMPAT ONLY. **V1 is OUR OWN prior work and is exempt: porting from it is explicitly wanted.** (2) Building art = USER via Nano Banana kits. (3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE FORTY-SIX RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE. 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW. 39 (§76): WINNING THE LAST WRITE DOES NOT SETTLE A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE TARGET. 40 (§75.h): A TRIPWIRE THAT FIRES BEFORE THE OBSERVER ATTACHES IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 (§77a): A STRUCT FIELD YOU NEVER SET IS A FEATURE YOU NEVER SHIPPED. 42 (§77b): THE DIRECTION A MOTION READS AS IS A PROPERTY OF THE THING, NOT OF THE ARRIVAL - and the far end is a DIFFERENT thing with its own axis. 43 (§78): **DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION.** 44 (§78b): AN OFFSET APPLIED WHOLE ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT, AND EVERY `DrawPos`-DERIVED OVERLAY STAYS BEHIND. 45 (§78d): **A DIRECTION OF TRAVEL IS NOT A DIRECTION OF ELEVATION.** Sliding along the run axis and shrinking says "went away", not "went up" - a climb needs a SCREEN-SPACE vertical term that is independent of which way the run points. 46 (§78d): **NON-UNIFORM SCALE x ROTATION = SHEAR.** Ours is not the only matrix in the chain (parent body angle, per-node scales), so `sx != sz` while `rot != 0` skews the pawn into a parallelogram. Squash-and-stretch OR lean, never both.

# 73. TRANSIT ANIMATIONS (V2 ROUND 1) — SUPERSEDED BY §78

Kept for the lesson. §73 shipped an INVERTED delay: instant carry, latency afterwards, as a ghost redrawn at the origin mouth while the real pawn stood at the destination. It existed because run #297 had deadlocked on a pre-hop hold. Its costs - a ghost draw pass, a hide pose, a suppressed name label, and a knowingly-shipped lie where the pawn was hittable at a destination it appeared not to be at - are all deleted by §78.

# 74. BLUEPRINT ART — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED

`ABBlueprintLook` retint; `Blueprint_ABBuild` stuff tint; `ABGhostGraphicForLinks` IsDoor bypass. Single knob `BlueprintAlpha`, consumed in TWO places (blueprint `GraphicData.color` AND `Blueprint_ABBuild.DrawColor`, which must re-apply it over the stuff colour or a stuffed plan comes back opaque). **§74.b:** 0.70 read as ALREADY BUILT; now **0.42**. ⚠ NOT field-confirmed.

# 75. WALL RISERS — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED, PLACEHOLDER ART

4 defs; a riser IS a `Building_ABColumn`; WallLamp attachment; no `holdsRoof`; cascade despawn. uiOrder: links 2060-2066, columns 2070-2073, risers 2080-2083. **§75.g `AB2: carrier probe`** - per-cell drawerType/IsCarrier/ShouldPrint census plus a live Harmony patch census. **Keep this tool.** **§75.h:** Dubwise layers derive from plain `SectionLayer`, declare NO `TakePrintFrom`, print from `Building_Pipe.PrintForGrid` - the old patch bound nothing for two windows. Now patched per host, deduped by MethodInfo, prefix INSPECTS the `SectionLayer` argument so unrecognised layers print rather than hide (rule 34).

# 76. PERSPECTIVE SHIFT — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED

Suspend `Avatar.UpdateCamera` via a parameterless prefix while the viewed band is not the avatar's (rule 39). On transit, snap the camera and NULL `Avatar.physicsPosition`. Freeze via `State.CameraLockPosition`; `lockedByUs` guards release. Cross-band shooting/traversal needed no code: PS gates on `verb.CanHitTarget`, which funnels through our `TryFindShootLineFromTo` patch. ⚠ NOT re-tested since §78 changed transit timing.

# 77. MOTION STUDY ROUND 2 — CLOSED. TRAVELER PICKED.

Five languages in `mockups/anim-A..E-*.html` over a shared kit: all four link types on the REAL art, 4-facing pawn, scrubbable timeline, PS avatar view, gold/red footprint edge markers, live C#-port panel. Machine-checked for NaN/range and railing crossings. **User picked C - Traveler at 0.30 playback** and asked for the delay to move BEFORE the hop. **D's structure-animation track (the building reacts) is the one unused idea worth revisiting** and is orthogonal to what shipped.

**⚠ §77a FACING (rule 41).** `PawnDrawParms.facing` is a writable `Rot4` on the struct our GetDrawParms postfix already takes by ref. **⚠ ALPHA: NO.** `tint` is writable but pawn materials are cutout; alpha needs `PawnRenderFlags.Invisible`, which routes through `InvisibilityMatPool.GetInvisibleMat` - a distortion shader with a hard-coded cyan multiply. Scale is the only vanish channel.

**§77b THE RAILING BUG, BOTH ENDS.** Decoded from the PNGs: every `*_south` sprite has its notch on its **NORTH** edge (`AB_StairsDown_south` north-edge coverage 42% vs 88/99/87). **Entry edge = `Opposite(Rotation)`, run direction = `Rotation.FacingCell`.** ⚠ **The counterpart shares this end's `Rotation` and that is load-bearing** (`GenAdj.AdjustForRotation` shifts even-sized footprints; `TryCellPairs` pairs cell i to cell i) - **DO NOT FLIP IT**.

**⚠ §77c ART DEFECTS - USER'S DOMAIN.** (a) `AB_GrandStairsDown/Up_east`/`_west` are the NORTH composition unrotated. (b) `AB_StairsDown_east/_west` differ in composition from north/south and sit 0.42 cells north. (c) `AB_StairsUp_east/_west` have no notch on any edge. (d) `AB_LadderUp_east` is a 0.14-cell sliver drawn 0.30 cells west. `ABStairAnim.ArtOffsets` transcribes these honestly.

# 78. PRE-HOP DELAY + THE V1 CLIMB GRAMMAR

**Structure.** `Carry` splits into `BeginCrossing` / `TickCrossings` / `CarryNow`. Both teleport sites (tick sweep AND `TryConsumeArrival`) route through it.

**⚠⚠ WHY THIS IS NOT RUN #297 (rule 43), AND THREE FIELD RUNS AGREE.** #297 held the pawn by REFUSING AN ARRIVAL, so `PatherArrived` never ran, the leg never completed, the job re-issued `StartPath`, `TrySegment` re-segmented forever. **The DECISION was deferred behind a cosmetic condition.** §78 defers only the POSITION WRITE: the record has already left `pending` and `everSegmented`, so there is no leg to re-segment. Held by **`StopDead()` + `StaggerFor`**, never by refusing an arrival - StopDead clears `moving` WITHOUT notifying the JobDriver, so the toil waits, no arrival fires at the stairwell, and `PatherTick` never re-tests `AtDestinationPosition`. On the arrival path, returning true is load-bearing and safe ONLY because StopDead already ran. Every exit teleports or abandons; anchor lost → `EndCurrentJob` (else it is `ABStuckWatchdog` episode B); job changed → cancel, no teleport; moved off the hold cell → fire early; `MaxHoldTicks` 300 backstops.

**§78b (field round 1: "teleports into the centre, nameplate wrong, facing wrong").** One root cause - the clip is authored about the LINK but nothing put the pawn AT the link. (1) **Travel, not teleport:** the absolute snap offset became `travelX/travelZ`, scaled by each pose's easing, so clips start at zero. (2) **Label follows the sprite:** postfix on `GenMapUI.LabelDrawPosFor(Thing, float)`; ⚠ delta computed in SCREEN space because the vanilla result is already projected AND y-flipped, so the y term subtracts. (3) **Facing from the actual vector**, not `Rotation.FacingCell`. (4) **`EntryCellFor`** rewrites the path destination to the link's entry side.

**§78c (field round 2: "still starts before they hit the stair texture").** The sweep carried any pawn within `ArriveRadius` = **3 cells**, so the clip began while the pawn was still walking. (1) `EntryCellFor` now returns the footprint cell just inside the notch - ⚠ tested with **`Walkable`, not `Standable`**, because a `Building_Door` is `PassThroughOnly` and `Standable` is false for every link cell. The approach is now real pathing at real walk speed. (2) The sweep waits for the pawn to be ON that cell. ⚠⚠ That is a NARROWER carry condition and narrowing it has jammed stairwells every previous time, so it is **delayed, never denied**: three triggers (on the cell / stopped short / `ApproachPatienceTicks` = 120 backstop) guarantee a crossing within two seconds.

**§78d (field round 3: "the animation isn't going up the stairs but in and down"). PORTED FROM V1** `Source/Stairs/ClimbAnimation.cs`. §78's Traveler grammar was slide-along-the-run + shrink-to-0.10 for BOTH directions - correct for a descent, meaningless for a climb (rule 45). V1 separates the terms, and its numbers are now ours verbatim:
- **SLIDE** toward the stairwell centre, eased, capped `SlideMax` 1.35 cells.
- **BOB** driven by TICKS not progress (period 12 stairs / 16 ladder, amp 0.05 / 0.08), so footfall rate is duration-independent.
- **VERT**, the actual fix: z −0.35 descending, +0.30 ascending. A screen-space rise/sink independent of which way the run points.
- **SCALE** ×0.72 descending, ×1.10 ascending - modest, and **uniform** (rule 46; the old non-uniform sx/sz with a lean was shearing the sprite into a parallelogram).
- **LEAN** `Sin(t*PI/24)*3°`, stairs only; ladders climb square-on, elevator passengers do not sway.
- **EMERGE** 22 ticks, ease-out `(1-p)²`, vertical INVERTED against the climb (down arrives from above: raised and ×1.12 settling; up arrives from below: sunken and ×0.82 growing).
- **Durations** now V1's: climb 90 ticks (ladder 110, elevator 90 + 16/level capped 130), emerge 22.

**⚠ OFFERED, NOT ACCEPTED: THE PIPELINE ITSELF.** V1 drove this through the native `AnimationDef` + `BaseAnimationWorker` API (`SetAnimation`, `OffsetAtTick`/`AngleAtTick`/`ScaleAtTick`) rather than a `GetDrawParms` matrix. That is strictly better for compat - it composes with Yayo's, Melee Animation and facial mods, and V1 explicitly checked `renderer.CurAnimation` to **never stomp a foreign animation**. Only the grammar was ported; the pipeline swap is ledger 11.

**⚠ RETIRED STUBS.** `IsGhosting` returns constant false and `DrawGhosts` is a no-op, documented, because they have live call sites in `ABBelowDynamicDraw`. Delete once §78 is proven.
